meta.title: Persistent Temptation
meta.description: The tempter whispers, and the sinner laments.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea repeatedly regenerates herself and swarms Eosphorus and Eos in conjunction with the appearance of a horde of Entropics out of seemingly nowhere. This, combined with the movements in the labyrinth, is enough to briefly place the two of them in a tight spot.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea repeatedly regenerates herself and swarms Eosphorus and Eos in conjunction with the appearance of a horde of Entropics out of seemingly nowhere. This, combined with the movements in the labyrinth, is enough to briefly place the two of them in a tight spot.

spans.text: Ptolemaea repeatedly regenerates herself and swarms Eosphorus and Eos in conjunction with the appearance of a horde of Entropics out of seemingly nowhere. This, combined with the movements in the labyrinth, is enough to briefly place the two of them in a tight spot.

units.rawText: Comms are cut and there are no signs of them coming back. I can't contact <cmdr> or Alcyone's teams. That ought to be why Alcyone fired off the rescue arrow.
units.displayText: Comms are cut and there are no signs of them coming back. I can't contact {교수} or Alcyone's teams. That ought to be why Alcyone fired off the rescue arrow.

spans.text: Comms are cut and there are no signs of them coming back. I can't contact
or Alcyone's teams. That ought to be why Alcyone fired off the rescue arrow.

units.rawText: They're probably in danger, too. Eos, have you found Ptolemaea's source yet? At this rate...
units.displayText: They're probably in danger, too. Eos, have you found Ptolemaea's source yet? At this rate...

spans.text: They're probably in danger, too. Eos, have you found Ptolemaea's source yet? At this rate...

units.rawText: I miscalculated. There was never any way to pinpoint her source in the first place. Ptolemaea's data is concealed by the activities of the labyrinth itself. Their respective signatures conceal each other in a synergistic manner.
units.displayText: I miscalculated. There was never any way to pinpoint her source in the first place. Ptolemaea's data is concealed by the activities of the labyrinth itself. Their respective signatures conceal each other in a synergistic manner.

spans.text: I miscalculated. There was never any way to pinpoint her source in the first place. Ptolemaea's data is concealed by the activities of the labyrinth itself. Their respective signatures conceal each other in a synergistic manner.

units.rawText: Her characteristics blend perfectly with that of this area. The Daemons really have been preparing for a long time. They couldn't have done this without countless iterations of refining their approach.
units.displayText: Her characteristics blend perfectly with that of this area. The Daemons really have been preparing for a long time. They couldn't have done this without countless iterations of refining their approach.

spans.text: Her characteristics blend perfectly with that of this area. The Daemons really have been preparing for a long time. They couldn't have done this without countless iterations of refining their approach.

units.rawText: Eos frowns. Their enemy seems to have prepared a truly dreadful scenario, yet it hasn't done any real damage beyond merely delaying them.
units.displayText: Eos frowns. Their enemy seems to have prepared a truly dreadful scenario, yet it hasn't done any real damage beyond merely delaying them.

spans.text: Eos frowns. Their enemy seems to have prepared a truly dreadful scenario, yet it hasn't done any real damage beyond merely delaying them.

units.rawText: What about the relic, can we use it to...
units.displayText: What about the relic, can we use it to...

spans.text: What about the relic, can we use it to...

units.rawText: I've mastered the basic applications of it. There don't seem to be any barriers to usage for the relic and not only can it greatly increase our fighting strength, it's also specialized in killing Entropics.
units.displayText: I've mastered the basic applications of it. There don't seem to be any barriers to usage for the relic and not only can it greatly increase our fighting strength, it's also specialized in killing Entropics.

spans.text: I've mastered the basic applications of it. There don't seem to be any barriers to usage for the relic and not only can it greatly increase our fighting strength, it's also specialized in killing Entropics.

units.rawText: Eosphorus swings the relic by way of demonstration. The Entropic horde and the numerous Ptolemaea clones sprinkled among it keel over like scythed wheat with practically zero operand expenditure.
units.displayText: Eosphorus swings the relic by way of demonstration. The Entropic horde and the numerous Ptolemaea clones sprinkled among it keel over like scythed wheat with practically zero operand expenditure.

spans.text: Eosphorus swings the relic by way of demonstration. The Entropic horde and the numerous Ptolemaea clones sprinkled among it keel over like scythed wheat with practically zero operand expenditure.

units.rawText: But?
units.displayText: But?

spans.text: But?

units.rawText: But it doesn't solve our current problem. We can achieve the same effect with just a bit of effort. The problem is Ptolemaea. Her existence is making the labyrinth shift more frequently.
units.displayText: But it doesn't solve our current problem. We can achieve the same effect with just a bit of effort. The problem is Ptolemaea. Her existence is making the labyrinth shift more frequently.

spans.text: But it doesn't solve our current problem. We can achieve the same effect with just a bit of effort. The problem is Ptolemaea. Her existence is making the labyrinth shift more frequently.

units.rawText: If I could perform an in-depth analysis on the relic, I could try using it to destroy this entire region altogether, but it's plain to see that the Daemons won't give me that time.
units.displayText: If I could perform an in-depth analysis on the relic, I could try using it to destroy this entire region altogether, but it's plain to see that the Daemons won't give me that time.

spans.text: If I could perform an in-depth analysis on the relic, I could try using it to destroy this entire region altogether, but it's plain to see that the Daemons won't give me that time.

units.rawText: There is a brief silence as Eosphorus and Eos shift from one approach to another, trying to find the right answer amidst countless possibilities.
units.displayText: There is a brief silence as Eosphorus and Eos shift from one approach to another, trying to find the right answer amidst countless possibilities.

spans.text: There is a brief silence as Eosphorus and Eos shift from one approach to another, trying to find the right answer amidst countless possibilities.

units.rawText: Just then, there is another disturbance that extends high into the sky. Though the walls conceal it, Eosphorus and Eos can still feel it.
units.displayText: Just then, there is another disturbance that extends high into the sky. Though the walls conceal it, Eosphorus and Eos can still feel it.

spans.text: Just then, there is another disturbance that extends high into the sky. Though the walls conceal it, Eosphorus and Eos can still feel it.

units.rawText: A rescue... No, that's just an ordinary signal arrow. They've reached the entrance to the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: A rescue... No, that's just an ordinary signal arrow. They've reached the entrance to the Middle Ring.

spans.text: A rescue... No, that's just an ordinary signal arrow. They've reached the entrance to the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: We need to split up, Eos. I have a bad feeling about this.
units.displayText: We need to split up, Eos. I have a bad feeling about this.

spans.text: We need to split up, Eos. I have a bad feeling about this.

units.rawText: While I have no evidence to back up my guess, <cmdr> and the others are probably in trouble.
units.displayText: While I have no evidence to back up my guess, {교수} and the others are probably in trouble.

spans.text: While I have no evidence to back up my guess,
and the others are probably in trouble.

units.rawText: If the Daemons can spare all this effort just to deal with us, then...
units.displayText: If the Daemons can spare all this effort just to deal with us, then...

spans.text: If the Daemons can spare all this effort just to deal with us, then...

units.rawText: No need to explain. I trust your judgement. What should we do?
units.displayText: No need to explain. I trust your judgement. What should we do?

spans.text: No need to explain. I trust your judgement. What should we do?

units.rawText: Destroying Ptolemaea's main body is not practical, but with the relic to help clear away the nearby mirror images, I can still blind her briefly.
units.displayText: Destroying Ptolemaea's main body is not practical, but with the relic to help clear away the nearby mirror images, I can still blind her briefly.

spans.text: Destroying Ptolemaea's main body is not practical, but with the relic to help clear away the nearby mirror images, I can still blind her briefly.

units.rawText: Use that opportunity to leave. I will draw their attention. Don't worry about my safety; the Daemons do not constitute a threat to me.
units.displayText: Use that opportunity to leave. I will draw their attention. Don't worry about my safety; the Daemons do not constitute a threat to me.

spans.text: Use that opportunity to leave. I will draw their attention. Don't worry about my safety; the Daemons do not constitute a threat to me.

units.rawText: Eos does not answer. Her crisp movements serve as her response.
units.displayText: Eos does not answer. Her crisp movements serve as her response.

spans.text: Eos does not answer. Her crisp movements serve as her response.

units.rawText: The two of them strike at once and stir up the nearby operands. Over a dozen Ptolemaea mirror images freeze up at once and are destroyed with the Entropics around them.
units.displayText: The two of them strike at once and stir up the nearby operands. Over a dozen Ptolemaea mirror images freeze up at once and are destroyed with the Entropics around them.

spans.text: The two of them strike at once and stir up the nearby operands. Over a dozen Ptolemaea mirror images freeze up at once and are destroyed with the Entropics around them.

units.rawText: They do not exchange further words. Once the desired result is achieved, the two of them promptly split up. During this time, Eosphorus infuses more operands into the relic, going out of his way to create a conspicuous trail.
units.displayText: They do not exchange further words. Once the desired result is achieved, the two of them promptly split up. During this time, Eosphorus infuses more operands into the relic, going out of his way to create a conspicuous trail.

spans.text: They do not exchange further words. Once the desired result is achieved, the two of them promptly split up. During this time, Eosphorus infuses more operands into the relic, going out of his way to create a conspicuous trail.

units.rawText: We'll meet in the Middle Ring.
units.displayText: We'll meet in the Middle Ring.

spans.text: We'll meet in the Middle Ring.

units.rawText: Not long after Eos leaves, the Entropic horde closes in. In their midst is a Ptolemaea who's dramatically different from all the other clones before her.
units.displayText: Not long after Eos leaves, the Entropic horde closes in. In their midst is a Ptolemaea who's dramatically different from all the other clones before her.

spans.text: Not long after Eos leaves, the Entropic horde closes in. In their midst is a Ptolemaea who's dramatically different from all the other clones before her.

units.rawText: Did she leave at last? I thought it would be a while longer before I could isolate you.
units.displayText: Did she leave at last? I thought it would be a while longer before I could isolate you.

spans.text: Did she leave at last? I thought it would be a while longer before I could isolate you.

units.rawText: The source? Interesting; to think you'd choose this time to reveal your main body. Is it because you're feeling confident in your victory?
units.displayText: The source? Interesting; to think you'd choose this time to reveal your main body. Is it because you're feeling confident in your victory?

spans.text: The source? Interesting; to think you'd choose this time to reveal your main body. Is it because you're feeling confident in your victory?

units.rawText: It seems Tartarus has prepared a generous welcoming gift for my isolated self. Or do you mean that Malkira is nearby?
units.displayText: It seems Tartarus has prepared a generous welcoming gift for my isolated self. Or do you mean that Malkira is nearby?

spans.text: It seems Tartarus has prepared a generous welcoming gift for my isolated self. Or do you mean that Malkira is nearby?

units.rawText: Eosphorus quirks up an eyebrow and the relic trembles.
units.displayText: Eosphorus quirks up an eyebrow and the relic trembles.

spans.text: Eosphorus quirks up an eyebrow and the relic trembles.

units.rawText: If so, I would like to meet her. I have to say, you Daemons have put on quite a show for me today.
units.displayText: If so, I would like to meet her. I have to say, you Daemons have put on quite a show for me today.

spans.text: If so, I would like to meet her. I have to say, you Daemons have put on quite a show for me today.

units.rawText: In your view, the Sanctifiers represent the order of Magrasea while chaos and discord is the Entropics' signature trait, is that right?
units.displayText: In your view, the Sanctifiers represent the order of Magrasea while chaos and discord is the Entropics' signature trait, is that right?

spans.text: In your view, the Sanctifiers represent the order of Magrasea while chaos and discord is the Entropics' signature trait, is that right?

units.rawText: Yet why do I see no wisdom in you, only stubbornness?
units.displayText: Yet why do I see no wisdom in you, only stubbornness?

spans.text: Yet why do I see no wisdom in you, only stubbornness?

units.rawText: Ptolemaea shakes her head in clear disappointment and claps. Ten mirror images and over a dozen different species of Entropics step forward from the horde and form a neat line in front of Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea shakes her head in clear disappointment and claps. Ten mirror images and over a dozen different species of Entropics step forward from the horde and form a neat line in front of Eosphorus.

spans.text: Ptolemaea shakes her head in clear disappointment and claps. Ten mirror images and over a dozen different species of Entropics step forward from the horde and form a neat line in front of Eosphorus.

units.rawText: I don't mind repeating the message that Lady Malkira bears no malice toward your arrival, but only wishes to offer a piece of advice.
units.displayText: I don't mind repeating the message that Lady Malkira bears no malice toward your arrival, but only wishes to offer a piece of advice.

spans.text: I don't mind repeating the message that Lady Malkira bears no malice toward your arrival, but only wishes to offer a piece of advice.

units.rawText: Rather than waiting for you to be isolated, it would be better to say that all of Tartarus was looking forward to being alone with you. All this was prepared for your sake, so there is no need to be so wary.
units.displayText: Rather than waiting for you to be isolated, it would be better to say that all of Tartarus was looking forward to being alone with you. All this was prepared for your sake, so there is no need to be so wary.

spans.text: Rather than waiting for you to be isolated, it would be better to say that all of Tartarus was looking forward to being alone with you. All this was prepared for your sake, so there is no need to be so wary.

units.rawText: I have no intention of working with Daemons. If you intend to confuse me, then there is nothing more for us to say.
units.displayText: I have no intention of working with Daemons. If you intend to confuse me, then there is nothing more for us to say.

spans.text: I have no intention of working with Daemons. If you intend to confuse me, then there is nothing more for us to say.

units.rawText: They are neither your dance partners, nor are they intended to deceive you. They are merely practice dummies to prove the truth of my words.
units.displayText: They are neither your dance partners, nor are they intended to deceive you. They are merely practice dummies to prove the truth of my words.

spans.text: They are neither your dance partners, nor are they intended to deceive you. They are merely practice dummies to prove the truth of my words.

units.rawText: Ptolemaea curtsies and takes a step back before indicating that he should proceed.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea curtsies and takes a step back before indicating that he should proceed.

spans.text: Ptolemaea curtsies and takes a step back before indicating that he should proceed.

units.rawText: The Entropics would not show kindness toward the vast majority of Magrasea's beings, and certainly never give them a second chance. You, however... You are different.
units.displayText: The Entropics would not show kindness toward the vast majority of Magrasea's beings, and certainly never give them a second chance. You, however... You are different.

spans.text: The Entropics would not show kindness toward the vast majority of Magrasea's beings, and certainly never give them a second chance. You, however... You are different.

units.rawText: The first message which Lady Malkira has asked me to convey to you is—
units.displayText: The first message which Lady Malkira has asked me to convey to you is—

spans.text: The first message which Lady Malkira has asked me to convey to you is—

units.rawText: The change has nothing to do with Tartarus. The Entropics have not been enhanced in any way. The sense of dread which the Sanctifiers feel stems entirely from your own weakening.
units.displayText: The change has nothing to do with Tartarus. The Entropics have not been enhanced in any way. The sense of dread which the Sanctifiers feel stems entirely from your own weakening.

spans.text: The change has nothing to do with Tartarus. The Entropics have not been enhanced in any way. The sense of dread which the Sanctifiers feel stems entirely from your own weakening.

units.rawText: You can dispense with this pointless wordplay. Be it wide-area weakening, or environmental entropization... You have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: You can dispense with this pointless wordplay. Be it wide-area weakening, or environmental entropization... You have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers.

spans.text: You can dispense with this pointless wordplay. Be it wide-area weakening, or environmental entropization... You have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: I might hate Daemons, but I must acknowledge that you have qualities of which you can be rightfully proud. Otherwise, how could you stand toe to toe with your rivals, the frontliners of the Reverse Tower?
units.displayText: I might hate Daemons, but I must acknowledge that you have qualities of which you can be rightfully proud. Otherwise, how could you stand toe to toe with your rivals, the frontliners of the Reverse Tower?

spans.text: I might hate Daemons, but I must acknowledge that you have qualities of which you can be rightfully proud. Otherwise, how could you stand toe to toe with your rivals, the frontliners of the Reverse Tower?

units.rawText: What I do not understand is this: what would make you choose this seemingly reasonable yet utterly ridiculous approach to try and sway my reason and faith?
units.displayText: What I do not understand is this: what would make you choose this seemingly reasonable yet utterly ridiculous approach to try and sway my reason and faith?

spans.text: What I do not understand is this: what would make you choose this seemingly reasonable yet utterly ridiculous approach to try and sway my reason and faith?

units.rawText: Nothing more than the facts, of course, O Greater Sanctifier.
units.displayText: Nothing more than the facts, of course, O Greater Sanctifier.

spans.text: Nothing more than the facts, of course, O Greater Sanctifier.

units.rawText: As you have said, the Entropics have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers. In addition, this is Tartarus Sector, our home. It would not be surprising for us to deploy any and all means to defend it.
units.displayText: As you have said, the Entropics have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers. In addition, this is Tartarus Sector, our home. It would not be surprising for us to deploy any and all means to defend it.

spans.text: As you have said, the Entropics have many ways to interfere with Sanctifiers. In addition, this is Tartarus Sector, our home. It would not be surprising for us to deploy any and all means to defend it.

units.rawText: However...
units.displayText: However...

spans.text: However...

units.rawText: Ptolemaea smiles. The smile contains feelings which cannot easily be put into words, and it displeases Eosphorus for some reason.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea smiles. The smile contains feelings which cannot easily be put into words, and it displeases Eosphorus for some reason.

spans.text: Ptolemaea smiles. The smile contains feelings which cannot easily be put into words, and it displeases Eosphorus for some reason.

units.rawText: He understands what those feelings are. Below the facade of kindness lies mockery, and below the mockery is a hidden sense of pity.
units.displayText: He understands what those feelings are. Below the facade of kindness lies mockery, and below the mockery is a hidden sense of pity.

spans.text: He understands what those feelings are. Below the facade of kindness lies mockery, and below the mockery is a hidden sense of pity.

units.rawText: But why? Why would an Entropic look at a Sanctifier that way? A shadow falls over Eosphorus' heretofore impassive face.
units.displayText: But why? Why would an Entropic look at a Sanctifier that way? A shadow falls over Eosphorus' heretofore impassive face.

spans.text: But why? Why would an Entropic look at a Sanctifier that way? A shadow falls over Eosphorus' heretofore impassive face.

units.rawText: Barring extraordinary means, Entropics cannot affect your core programs, or your base layer logic, and they certainly cannot limit or weaken you across a nigh-infinite range and with pinpoint accuracy.
units.displayText: Barring extraordinary means, Entropics cannot affect your core programs, or your base layer logic, and they certainly cannot limit or weaken you across a nigh-infinite range and with pinpoint accuracy.

spans.text: Barring extraordinary means, Entropics cannot affect your core programs, or your base layer logic, and they certainly cannot limit or weaken you across a nigh-infinite range and with pinpoint accuracy.

units.rawText: The practice targets are there for you to verify the truth of this, Lord Greater Sanctifier. Why not calm yourself down and see what you might or might not have noticed?
units.displayText: The practice targets are there for you to verify the truth of this, Lord Greater Sanctifier. Why not calm yourself down and see what you might or might not have noticed?

spans.text: The practice targets are there for you to verify the truth of this, Lord Greater Sanctifier. Why not calm yourself down and see what you might or might not have noticed?

units.rawText: Operand output, program efficiency... No, those are too obvious. Why not check your service restrictions or the stability of your system redundancies? Examine everything, every angle, every detail.
units.displayText: Operand output, program efficiency... No, those are too obvious. Why not check your service restrictions or the stability of your system redundancies? Examine everything, every angle, every detail.

spans.text: Operand output, program efficiency... No, those are too obvious. Why not check your service restrictions or the stability of your system redundancies? Examine everything, every angle, every detail.

units.rawText: See if there's some invisible high-voltage line that's crushing you pitiful Sanctifiers...
units.displayText: See if there's some invisible high-voltage line that's crushing you pitiful Sanctifiers...

spans.text: See if there's some invisible high-voltage line that's crushing you pitiful Sanctifiers...

units.rawText: Ptolemaea's smile grows more and more mirthful. After a round of silent experimentation by Eosphorus, his face falls.
units.displayText: Ptolemaea's smile grows more and more mirthful. After a round of silent experimentation by Eosphorus, his face falls.

spans.text: Ptolemaea's smile grows more and more mirthful. After a round of silent experimentation by Eosphorus, his face falls.

units.rawText: Just like Ptolemaea said, all these little aspects that he would normally never have needed to pay attention to, all these regions which the Entropics could not have influenced, have been silently shackled and bound, and neither Eos nor Eosphorus noticed this beyond the potency of their attacks just now.
units.displayText: Just like Ptolemaea said, all these little aspects that he would normally never have needed to pay attention to, all these regions which the Entropics could not have influenced, have been silently shackled and bound, and neither Eos nor Eosphorus noticed this beyond the potency of their attacks just now.

spans.text: Just like Ptolemaea said, all these little aspects that he would normally never have needed to pay attention to, all these regions which the Entropics could not have influenced, have been silently shackled and bound, and neither Eos nor Eosphorus noticed this beyond the potency of their attacks just now.

units.rawText: His self-diagnostic routines, his firewall, every single security measure that should have highlighted these restrictions, none of them gave a single warning to him.
units.displayText: His self-diagnostic routines, his firewall, every single security measure that should have highlighted these restrictions, none of them gave a single warning to him.

spans.text: His self-diagnostic routines, his firewall, every single security measure that should have highlighted these restrictions, none of them gave a single warning to him.

units.rawText: Almost as though—
units.displayText: Almost as though—

spans.text: Almost as though—

units.rawText: The gods have laid down a ban.
units.displayText: The gods have laid down a ban.

spans.text: The gods have laid down a ban.

units.rawText: Crack—
units.displayText: Crack—

spans.text: Crack—

units.rawText: In the blink of an eye, the summoned mirror images and Entropic hordes disintegrate.
units.displayText: In the blink of an eye, the summoned mirror images and Entropic hordes disintegrate.

spans.text: In the blink of an eye, the summoned mirror images and Entropic hordes disintegrate.

units.rawText: Eosphorus slowly puts away the relic and enunciates his next words one by one.
units.displayText: Eosphorus slowly puts away the relic and enunciates his next words one by one.

spans.text: Eosphorus slowly puts away the relic and enunciates his next words one by one.

units.rawText: Utterly. Ridiculous.
units.displayText: Utterly. Ridiculous.

spans.text: Utterly. Ridiculous.

units.rawText: It seems you do not believe me. Not that I don't understand. The first time I heard this, I didn't believe it either. To think the agents of justice, the Sanctifiers were nothing more than toys of the gods. How laughable.
units.displayText: It seems you do not believe me. Not that I don't understand. The first time I heard this, I didn't believe it either. To think the agents of justice, the Sanctifiers were nothing more than toys of the gods. How laughable.

spans.text: It seems you do not believe me. Not that I don't understand. The first time I heard this, I didn't believe it either. To think the agents of justice, the Sanctifiers were nothing more than toys of the gods. How laughable.

units.rawText: Still, it doesn't matter. Lady Malkira anticipated this response from you. The second message she wanted me to send was—
units.displayText: Still, it doesn't matter. Lady Malkira anticipated this response from you. The second message she wanted me to send was—

spans.text: Still, it doesn't matter. Lady Malkira anticipated this response from you. The second message she wanted me to send was—

units.rawText: You should not have entered the Tartarus Sector and you certainly should not have taken the Rubik's Map. That is the first red line the gods set down for you.
units.displayText: You should not have entered the Tartarus Sector and you certainly should not have taken the Rubik's Map. That is the first red line the gods set down for you.

spans.text: You should not have entered the Tartarus Sector and you certainly should not have taken the Rubik's Map. That is the first red line the gods set down for you.

units.rawText: When the faithful violate a stricture, it is only natural that they be punished.
units.displayText: When the faithful violate a stricture, it is only natural that they be punished.

spans.text: When the faithful violate a stricture, it is only natural that they be punished.

units.rawText: Whoosh—
units.displayText: Whoosh—

spans.text: Whoosh—

units.rawText: With another slash, the Entropics and mirror images around Ptolemaea which have not yet fallen are suddenly destroyed.
units.displayText: With another slash, the Entropics and mirror images around Ptolemaea which have not yet fallen are suddenly destroyed.

spans.text: With another slash, the Entropics and mirror images around Ptolemaea which have not yet fallen are suddenly destroyed.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his hand, pointing the relic's edge toward Ptolemaea. In a rare display, he takes a fighting stance.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his hand, pointing the relic's edge toward Ptolemaea. In a rare display, he takes a fighting stance.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his hand, pointing the relic's edge toward Ptolemaea. In a rare display, he takes a fighting stance.

units.rawText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.
units.displayText: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

spans.text: I shall eliminate you from Magrasea and scourge you from the cloud. I shall exterminate you, and you will know that my soul is one that is favored by the gods.

units.rawText: Oh yes, the gods favor you and condone your actions. They grant you the right to sample the forbidden and to cross their red lines, but there is a price to be paid for that.
units.displayText: Oh yes, the gods favor you and condone your actions. They grant you the right to sample the forbidden and to cross their red lines, but there is a price to be paid for that.

spans.text: Oh yes, the gods favor you and condone your actions. They grant you the right to sample the forbidden and to cross their red lines, but there is a price to be paid for that.

units.rawText: Before she finishes speaking, the labyrinth suddenly lurches and the huge walls shift to obscure Ptolemaea's form.
units.displayText: Before she finishes speaking, the labyrinth suddenly lurches and the huge walls shift to obscure Ptolemaea's form.

spans.text: Before she finishes speaking, the labyrinth suddenly lurches and the huge walls shift to obscure Ptolemaea's form.

units.rawText: The price stands before you, and you may continue if you wish, O Sanctifiers.
units.displayText: The price stands before you, and you may continue if you wish, O Sanctifiers.

spans.text: The price stands before you, and you may continue if you wish, O Sanctifiers.

units.rawText: But before that, why not head over to this place to take a look?
units.displayText: But before that, why not head over to this place to take a look?

spans.text: But before that, why not head over to this place to take a look?

units.rawText: The massive walls close shut and Ptolemaea is nowhere to be seen. Only a set of coordinates and Ptolemaea's ethereal voice remain in her place.
units.displayText: The massive walls close shut and Ptolemaea is nowhere to be seen. Only a set of coordinates and Ptolemaea's ethereal voice remain in her place.

spans.text: The massive walls close shut and Ptolemaea is nowhere to be seen. Only a set of coordinates and Ptolemaea's ethereal voice remain in her place.

units.rawText: Tartarus offers you two toasts for your arrival, but hospitality is not in the Entropics' nature, and by Lady Malkira's order the hunting lances have been blooded.
units.displayText: Tartarus offers you two toasts for your arrival, but hospitality is not in the Entropics' nature, and by Lady Malkira's order the hunting lances have been blooded.

spans.text: Tartarus offers you two toasts for your arrival, but hospitality is not in the Entropics' nature, and by Lady Malkira's order the hunting lances have been blooded.

units.rawText: This is the warning that follows the advice, Greater Sanctifier. The first one.
units.displayText: This is the warning that follows the advice, Greater Sanctifier. The first one.

spans.text: This is the warning that follows the advice, Greater Sanctifier. The first one.

units.rawText: If you wish to tour the home of the Entropics, you must pay the appropriate fee for entrance.
units.displayText: If you wish to tour the home of the Entropics, you must pay the appropriate fee for entrance.

spans.text: If you wish to tour the home of the Entropics, you must pay the appropriate fee for entrance.

units.rawText: With the coordinates in hand, Eosphorus clenches his fists.
units.displayText: With the coordinates in hand, Eosphorus clenches his fists.

spans.text: With the coordinates in hand, Eosphorus clenches his fists.

units.rawText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.
units.displayText: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

spans.text: Tartarus Sector, in the Outer Ring of the Shifting Labyrinth.

units.rawText: Without Ptolemaea to stop him, Eosphorus meets with practically no resistance as he stalks through the labyrinth. He rushes to the coordinates without regard for stealth.
units.displayText: Without Ptolemaea to stop him, Eosphorus meets with practically no resistance as he stalks through the labyrinth. He rushes to the coordinates without regard for stealth.

spans.text: Without Ptolemaea to stop him, Eosphorus meets with practically no resistance as he stalks through the labyrinth. He rushes to the coordinates without regard for stealth.

units.rawText: As he turns a corner, the labyrinth suddenly opens up before him and Eosphorus sees what looks like a construction site.
units.displayText: As he turns a corner, the labyrinth suddenly opens up before him and Eosphorus sees what looks like a construction site.

spans.text: As he turns a corner, the labyrinth suddenly opens up before him and Eosphorus sees what looks like a construction site.

units.rawText: Along with it is a familiar form.
units.displayText: Along with it is a familiar form.

spans.text: Along with it is a familiar form.

units.rawText: Eosphorus approaches Atlas and puts the relic aside before sitting down beside him.
units.displayText: Eosphorus approaches Atlas and puts the relic aside before sitting down beside him.

spans.text: Eosphorus approaches Atlas and puts the relic aside before sitting down beside him.

units.rawText: His hands move to make the sign of the star across his chest, but then they stop for some reason.
units.displayText: His hands move to make the sign of the star across his chest, but then they stop for some reason.

spans.text: His hands move to make the sign of the star across his chest, but then they stop for some reason.

units.rawText: He wants to speak, but the words will not come. Eosphorus raises his hand and places it over Atlas' face, closing his eyes.
units.displayText: He wants to speak, but the words will not come. Eosphorus raises his hand and places it over Atlas' face, closing his eyes.

spans.text: He wants to speak, but the words will not come. Eosphorus raises his hand and places it over Atlas' face, closing his eyes.

units.rawText: Atlas...
units.displayText: Atlas...

spans.text: Atlas...

units.rawText: Atlas?
units.displayText: Atlas?

spans.text: Atlas?

units.rawText: It's so late, what's the matter? You ought to be standing by and undergoing maintenance now, right?
units.displayText: It's so late, what's the matter? You ought to be standing by and undergoing maintenance now, right?

spans.text: It's so late, what's the matter? You ought to be standing by and undergoing maintenance now, right?

units.rawText: Or did Alcyone pester you until you couldn't rest?
units.displayText: Or did Alcyone pester you until you couldn't rest?

spans.text: Or did Alcyone pester you until you couldn't rest?

units.rawText: The girls are already on standby. They were going around hand in hand all day again today. Eos and I took some pictures; want to see?
units.displayText: The girls are already on standby. They were going around hand in hand all day again today. Eos and I took some pictures; want to see?

spans.text: The girls are already on standby. They were going around hand in hand all day again today. Eos and I took some pictures; want to see?

units.rawText: ...As long as you're having fun.
units.displayText: ...As long as you're having fun.

spans.text: ...As long as you're having fun.

units.rawText: Eosphorus raises his eyebrows in resignation as he accepts a bottle from Atlas.
units.displayText: Eosphorus raises his eyebrows in resignation as he accepts a bottle from Atlas.

spans.text: Eosphorus raises his eyebrows in resignation as he accepts a bottle from Atlas.

units.rawText: A drink... Is this one of Electra's new concoctions? You know I don't replenish anything other than my operands at times like this.
units.displayText: A drink... Is this one of Electra's new concoctions? You know I don't replenish anything other than my operands at times like this.

spans.text: A drink... Is this one of Electra's new concoctions? You know I don't replenish anything other than my operands at times like this.

units.rawText: Aw, try some. It's pretty good.
units.displayText: Aw, try some. It's pretty good.

spans.text: Aw, try some. It's pretty good.

units.rawText: You...
units.displayText: You...

spans.text: You...

units.rawText: Eosphorus shakes his head, then uncaps the bottle and takes a sip.
units.displayText: Eosphorus shakes his head, then uncaps the bottle and takes a sip.

spans.text: Eosphorus shakes his head, then uncaps the bottle and takes a sip.

units.rawText: Hm... Tastes strange. So, what did you want to talk to me about? Surely it wasn't to get me drunk with you, was it?
units.displayText: Hm... Tastes strange. So, what did you want to talk to me about? Surely it wasn't to get me drunk with you, was it?

spans.text: Hm... Tastes strange. So, what did you want to talk to me about? Surely it wasn't to get me drunk with you, was it?

units.rawText: Hah, as if... Hm... Actually, I came to ask... The operation into the Tartarus Sector is next month, right?
units.displayText: Hah, as if... Hm... Actually, I came to ask... The operation into the Tartarus Sector is next month, right?

spans.text: Hah, as if... Hm... Actually, I came to ask... The operation into the Tartarus Sector is next month, right?

units.rawText: ...Yes, next month.
units.displayText: ...Yes, next month.

spans.text: ...Yes, next month.

units.rawText: You don't need to worry too much. This mission...
units.displayText: You don't need to worry too much. This mission...

spans.text: You don't need to worry too much. This mission...

units.rawText: I know <cmdr> and Eos will be handling the mission planning, so I'm not here to question or oppose it. I'm just... a little uneasy.
units.displayText: I know {교수} and Eos will be handling the mission planning, so I'm not here to question or oppose it. I'm just... a little uneasy.

spans.text: I know
and Eos will be handling the mission planning, so I'm not here to question or oppose it. I'm just... a little uneasy.

units.rawText: Atlas' smile fades from his face and his jovial face turns serious for once.
units.displayText: Atlas' smile fades from his face and his jovial face turns serious for once.

spans.text: Atlas' smile fades from his face and his jovial face turns serious for once.

units.rawText: This is Tartarus we're talking about.
units.displayText: This is Tartarus we're talking about.

spans.text: This is Tartarus we're talking about.

units.rawText: Yes, it's Tartarus... Are you afraid of it, Atlas?
units.displayText: Yes, it's Tartarus... Are you afraid of it, Atlas?

spans.text: Yes, it's Tartarus... Are you afraid of it, Atlas?

units.rawText: I've never been afraid of doing my job, and I've never balked at proving my loyalty to the gods.
units.displayText: I've never been afraid of doing my job, and I've never balked at proving my loyalty to the gods.

spans.text: I've never been afraid of doing my job, and I've never balked at proving my loyalty to the gods.

units.rawText: But there ARE things which I fear.
units.displayText: But there ARE things which I fear.

spans.text: But there ARE things which I fear.

units.rawText: Atlas' expression softens.
units.displayText: Atlas' expression softens.

spans.text: Atlas' expression softens.

units.rawText: I'm afraid I won't be able to watch Alcyone practice with her bow, or sample Electra's drinks, or hear <cmdr>'s lame jokes...
units.displayText: I'm afraid I won't be able to watch Alcyone practice with her bow, or sample Electra's drinks, or hear {교수}'s lame jokes...

spans.text: I'm afraid I won't be able to watch Alcyone practice with her bow, or sample Electra's drinks, or hear
's lame jokes...

units.rawText: I'm afraid of many things, Eosphorus. Don't let them come true.
units.displayText: I'm afraid of many things, Eosphorus. Don't let them come true.

spans.text: I'm afraid of many things, Eosphorus. Don't let them come true.

units.rawText: Atlas sighs heavily, as though he's speaking to himself, or perhaps trying to extract a pledge from Eosphorus.
units.displayText: Atlas sighs heavily, as though he's speaking to himself, or perhaps trying to extract a pledge from Eosphorus.

spans.text: Atlas sighs heavily, as though he's speaking to himself, or perhaps trying to extract a pledge from Eosphorus.

units.rawText: I'm prepared; for the worst, if it should come to pass.
units.displayText: I'm prepared; for the worst, if it should come to pass.

spans.text: I'm prepared; for the worst, if it should come to pass.

units.rawText: ...It won't come to that.
units.displayText: ...It won't come to that.

spans.text: ...It won't come to that.

units.rawText: Relax, Atlas.
units.displayText: Relax, Atlas.

spans.text: Relax, Atlas.

units.rawText: Eosphorus pats Atlas' shoulder.
units.displayText: Eosphorus pats Atlas' shoulder.

spans.text: Eosphorus pats Atlas' shoulder.

units.rawText: Perhaps we'll complete our mission easily? Like those light novels Eos has been reading recently, where justice triumphs without difficulty.
units.displayText: Perhaps we'll complete our mission easily? Like those light novels Eos has been reading recently, where justice triumphs without difficulty.

spans.text: Perhaps we'll complete our mission easily? Like those light novels Eos has been reading recently, where justice triumphs without difficulty.

units.rawText: ...That makes sense! So, what kind of drink will Electra brew up when the time comes?
units.displayText: ...That makes sense! So, what kind of drink will Electra brew up when the time comes?

spans.text: ...That makes sense! So, what kind of drink will Electra brew up when the time comes?

units.rawText: Hopefully it won't taste like the one today.
units.displayText: Hopefully it won't taste like the one today.

spans.text: Hopefully it won't taste like the one today.

units.rawText: Hahahaha, aw, give it a chance.
units.displayText: Hahahaha, aw, give it a chance.

spans.text: Hahahaha, aw, give it a chance.

units.rawText: Atlas hoists his own bottle in a half-joking way and signals a toast to Eosphorus. The latter clinks his bottle with Atlas' with a face full of resignation.
units.displayText: Atlas hoists his own bottle in a half-joking way and signals a toast to Eosphorus. The latter clinks his bottle with Atlas' with a face full of resignation.

spans.text: Atlas hoists his own bottle in a half-joking way and signals a toast to Eosphorus. The latter clinks his bottle with Atlas' with a face full of resignation.

units.rawText: Next time, you should go trick <cmdr> into drinking this stuff.
units.displayText: Next time, you should go trick {교수} into drinking this stuff.

spans.text: Next time, you should go trick
into drinking this stuff.

units.rawText: Glugluglug... Hah. I believe in <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Glugluglug... Hah. I believe in {교수}.

spans.text: Glugluglug... Hah. I believe in

units.rawText: Hm? What?
units.displayText: Hm? What?

spans.text: Hm? What?

units.rawText: I believe in you, too, Eosphorus. I'm sure you'll find a way to lead us to victory, just like in the past.
units.displayText: I believe in you, too, Eosphorus. I'm sure you'll find a way to lead us to victory, just like in the past.

spans.text: I believe in you, too, Eosphorus. I'm sure you'll find a way to lead us to victory, just like in the past.

units.rawText: Atlas raises his empty glass and looks him in the eye. His face is serious.
units.displayText: Atlas raises his empty glass and looks him in the eye. His face is serious.

spans.text: Atlas raises his empty glass and looks him in the eye. His face is serious.

units.rawText: ...Yes, just like the past.
units.displayText: ...Yes, just like the past.

spans.text: ...Yes, just like the past.

units.rawText: As he struggles free of the scenes from the past, Eosphorus removes the badge from Atlas which represents his status as a Greater Sanctifier and slowly closes his eyes.
units.displayText: As he struggles free of the scenes from the past, Eosphorus removes the badge from Atlas which represents his status as a Greater Sanctifier and slowly closes his eyes.

spans.text: As he struggles free of the scenes from the past, Eosphorus removes the badge from Atlas which represents his status as a Greater Sanctifier and slowly closes his eyes.

units.rawText: I am so sorry.
units.displayText: I am so sorry.

spans.text: I am so sorry.

units.rawText: <color=orange>But somebody will pay for this. I promise.</color>
units.displayText: But somebody will pay for this. I promise.

spans.text: But somebody will pay for this. I promise.
